reply_text:
*One merge blocker* in `leaderboard-sort` vs `main`:

• *High — `src/rank.js:3`: sorting loses score precision.* `b.score - a.score` coerces decimal strings to Numbers, violating the documented support for scores above 2^53. Verified that input scores `"9007199254740992"` followed by `"9007199254740993"` incorrectly rank the lower score first; `topN(entries, 1)` also returns the wrong winner.
  *Recommended fix:* use the existing exact comparator: `.sort((a, b) => compareScore(b.score, a.score))`. Add a regression test with those scores.

All 3 existing tests pass, but `test/rank.test.js` only tests small scores and misses this regression. No other findings. No code changed.
